description: This source file provides implementations for HTTP ETag manipulation, including creation, matching, and remixing of ETags based on file system metadata and internal algorithms.

methods.name: int http_etag_matches(const buffer * const etag,const char * s,const int weak_ok)
methods.description: Determines if a given ETag matches any of a list of ETags or wildcards, considering weak or strong validation based on the 'weak_ok' parameter.

methods.name: void http_etag_remix(buffer * const etag,const char * const str,const uint32_t len)
methods.description: Remixes or updates an existing ETag buffer by hashing a string and embedding it within quotes.

methods.name: void http_etag_create(buffer * const etag,const struct stat * const st,const int flags)
methods.description: Creates an ETag based on file metadata (inode, size, modification time) and flags, using hashing to generate the tag content.
